description:
Deliver the owner-requested end-to-end process with strict repository concerns. benchbox-sqlglot discovers/integrates upstream, owns its protected PR/CI lifecycle, verifies source/build/runtime/distribution and provides a trustworthy immutable wheel delivery. BenchBox core only consumes that product, validates origin/identity/hash, updates its pin transactionally, runs minimal unique consumer integration/packaging checks and lands its ordinary core PR. Theseus stays independent and unchanged. No central core upstream orchestrator, external-source review inlet, duplicate fork suite or reviewer release.

Reuse fork refresh/build/verify and existing core adopter/packaging/pr-arm helpers. Separate producer and consumer controls/credentials/issues; proven cutover retires legacy core upstream automation without dual writers. Preserve holds/disarms, reverted-delivery suppression, exact canonical artifact identity, no-write dry-run/kill switches, baseline outcomes and separate public release authority. Current owner instruction supersedes source semantics review at core adoption; document that change rather than carry an obsolete decision. No-op deployment and first successful eligible release remain distinct.
